page1_source_units: Record the route of water before opening the demonstration gate.
1. Match marker M-0042 to the intake register.
a. Read the final two digits aloud; do not shorten 0042 to 42.
2. Place ruler R-0006 against the lower sill.
Figure 1. Water route; arrows show the observed direction.
Note 1. The route is descriptive; gate opening requires a separate permit.
page2_before_table: Repeat the marker reading at the outlet and retain both observations.
page2_after_table: Table note. -- means no observation; it is different from depth 0 cm.
1. Keep the gate closed if either reading is missing.
2. File the card with Procedure MG-023, revision 2.
Reference: Survey register SR-0019, section 4 (synthetic internal reference).
page3_scan_units: At 06:40, the north inlet was clear.
a. Include ruler R-0006 in the frame.
Card note: a clear inlet does not establish safe passage.
